items.html: And the matter is that the Yesod of the male is long, protruding, and substantial; and this is because the male is in the secret of Hesed spreading within him, and the abundance of the illumination of the Hassadim causes great influence in his Yesod, and it protrudes outward from the abundance of its illumination. But the Yesod of the female is very short, and it is in the secret of air and a cavity, and is not substantial; because the female is in the secret of the Gevurot spreading within her, as is known, and the Gevurot do not illuminate like the Hassadim; for the female is called darkness, as is known, and there is not in her the power for her Yesod to protrude. Therefore it remains in the secret of air. And therefore it ceases at the chest of ZA, and does not spread to the Yesod of ZA, to complete the rest of the Sefirot within it.
